headline: Rays of Belief Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - MOMSBELIEF: Rays of Belief Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of City Pro Group Inc. by Mom s Belief US Inc., a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of Rays of Belief Limited.
